correctness.rationale: Exact all-n parity calculation: det(J-I-P)=n-2 for odd n and 0 for even n, with verified Fourier eigenvalues and direct n=3..9 checks. Every exchange is an odd transposition; bipartite Hamiltonian paths require color classes differ at most one. The 80 lexicographic-state witness is exhaustive, closes, and is independently replayed in Python and C++; independent all-source BFS yields 207 edges and eccentricities 5:48,6:32. Direct exhaustive n=5 calculation gives 11+1+1 components. No inference from finite tests to an unbounded claim.

value.rationale: Natural ménage class and smallest nontrivial local cyclic Gray-code instance: n=5 has locked states, n=6 admits a full 80-arrangement cyclic listing. For every odd n>=5, the exact determinant parity defect prohibits even Hamiltonian paths. The contrast refines classical mere enumeration, supplies a positive reproducible Gray-code benchmark, and gives an infinite structural obstruction applicable to switch-chain and local enumeration. Diameter/radius are secondary, not the core novelty.
